userStories.title: The answering service — grounded, budgeted, cited
userStories.description: orchestrator/services/orchestrator_answers.py: answer_clarification(db, subject, question) → {answer, sources: [...refs]} | {cannot_answer, reason}. Retrieval scope: the run's mission plan + upstream task results (reuse _prepare_task's digest source), the mission field docs, memory (existing PRD-206 surface), the intake/business corpus via the EXISTING RAG stack (S3 Vectors), and 228's fleet state when the question is about the floor. Every answer carries its source refs; nothing retrievable → cannot_answer (no LLM freestyle: the LLM call is composition over retrieved context, and an empty retrieval short-circuits BEFORE any LLM call). Per-run budget: CLARIFICATION_BUDGET (config.py, default 3) — count on the run, budget-exhausted → cannot_answer(budget). Governance-category detection (destructive/spend/scope keywords + the caller's declared category param) → skip answering entirely, return escalate_directly. Every Q&A (answered or not) appended to the run's event trail via the existing progress ledger.
